description:
## Features

### YouTube
- **Built-in player subtitles, appearance:** More ways to style the subtitles in the built-in player's CC menu.
  - **Background opacity** slider from 0 to 100%. The default is 60%.
  - **Custom vertical position** slider. Bottom, Middle and Top stay as presets. The position stays the same relative place in portrait and landscape, and the subtitle always stays fully inside the video.
  - **Custom colour:** pick any colour with RVX's colour picker, with your recent colours. The four presets stay.
  - **Fonts:** seven built-in fonts (Default, Sans-serif medium, Condensed, Serif, Monospace, Casual, Cursive).
  - Your existing subtitle style carries over.

## Bug Fixes

### YouTube
- **Built-in player subtitles:** The subtitle background is now a rounded box that fits the text instead of a bar across the whole width. Long lines wrap within 90% of the video width, and the padding grows with the text size. At 0% opacity there is no background.
  - The default background is now 60% instead of none. If you never changed the subtitle style, you will see the box. Set the opacity to 0% to remove it.

## Compatibility
- YouTube: **21.39.525, 21.13.164, 20.05.46**.
- YouTube Music: **9.40.51, 9.15.51, 8.30.54**.

[Full changelog](https://github.com/lavinhoque33/revanced-patches/compare/v1.28.0...v1.29.0)
